documents.title: Guidance on the Use of AI in Teaching and Learning
documents.summary: Guidance from the Vice Provost for Teaching and Learning that leaves AI authorization to each instructor at the course level and lists what the syllabus should say. It also gives principles for AI-assisted grading, distrust of AI detectors, copyright and FERPA.
documents.stance_why: The page says 'Authorization is determined at the course level by the instructor' and that instructors 'should determine and inform students when the use of AI is authorized or unauthorized'. It sets no default allow or ban, so it delegates.
